title: Itervox hub notification settings
description: The hub's notification settings: ~/.itervox/hub/notifications.json (0600). Per project and per event kind, which channels (push, slack, desktop) an event of the merged feed goes to; per-project snooze; and the digest interval of low-priority kinds. The hub rewrites this file when the settings are saved from the dashboard (Hub -> Notifications) or PUT /hub/api/v1/notifications, and reads it when it starts.

$schema.description: The schema URL, for editor support.

digest_interval_minutes.description: Low-priority kinds are batched into a digest sent at most once per this many minutes. Input required and guardrail approval are never batched.

channels.description: A switch per channel for every project. A channel left out is on.

defaults.description: The route of each kind for a project without its own. A kind left out uses the built-in default: input_required, guardrail_approval and run_failed go to every channel; the other kinds are off.

projects.description: Per-project settings, keyed by the hub project name (the /hub/p/{project} segment).

channelList.description: The channels a kind goes to; empty turns the kind off.

snooze_until.description: Every notification of the project is suppressed until this time (RFC 3339).
